The data are the Sachs flow cytometry set. In the consensus signalling network from that work, plcg and pjnk are not directly linked. PKC drives pjnk, and plcg acts through PIP2, so neither protein sits directly upstream of the other. Their Spearman correlation is only 0.26, a weak association that is best explained by shared upstream regulators such as PKC rather than a direct causal edge. I did not run a causal-discovery analysis on the data, so this rests on the known network plus that correlation.

ANSWER: C
